name: ultimate-agent-stack
description: A guided, npm-distributed operating system with replaceable review and knowledge providers.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous delivery with proof and review gates.
interface.longDescription: Safely installs and updates a repository, guides consequential decisions with recommendations, selects replaceable review and knowledge providers, shapes ambiguous work conversationally, manages bounded native subagents, verifies behavior, and closes review loops while preserving human authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $run-autonomous-delivery to take my request from guided discovery through verified review closure and durable learning. If this repository is not configured yet, run $setup-autonomous-project first.
